import qs from 'query-string'; import SoundFont from './src/index.js'; // Constants const CSS_CLASS = { DRAG_ACTIVE: 'bg-info', }; const ELEMENT_IDS = { FILE_INPUT: 'file', DRAG_AREA: 'drag', BUILD_TIME: 'build', DARK_MODE_TOGGLE: 'toggleDarkMode', SOUNDFONT_NAME: 'soundfont', }; // Default options const defaultOptions = { drawSynth: true, placeholder: 'placeholder', colorMode: 'auto', }; // Merge options from URL parameters const options = { ...defaultOptions, ...qs.parse(window.location.search), ...qs.parse(window.location.hash), }; /** @type {typeof import("./src/wml").WebMidiLink} */ const wml = new SoundFont.WebMidiLink(options); /** * Extract filename from URL * @param {string} url * @returns {string} */ const extractFilename = url => { const match = decodeURIComponent(url).match('.+/(.+?)([?#;].*)?$'); return match ? match[1] : url; }; /** * Update soundfont display name * @param {string} name */ const updateSoundfontName = name => { document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.SOUNDFONT_NAME).innerText = name; }; /** * Load sound font from file * @param {File} file */ const loadSoundFont = file => { const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = e => { updateSoundfontName(file.name); const data = new Uint8Array(e.target.result); wml.setupByBuffer(data); }; reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file); }; /** * Setup drag area visual feedback * @param {HTMLElement} element */ const setupDragHandlers = element => { const handlers = { drop: event => { const files = event.dataTransfer?.files; if (files?.length) { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); loadSoundFont(files[0]); } element.classList.remove(CSS_CLASS.DRAG_ACTIVE); }, dragover: event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); element.classList.add(CSS_CLASS.DRAG_ACTIVE); }, dragleave: event => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); element.classList.remove(CSS_CLASS.DRAG_ACTIVE); }, }; Object.entries(handlers).forEach(([event, handler]) => { element.addEventListener(event, handler, false); }); }; /** * Setup color mode watcher * @param {HTMLInputElement} toggle */ const setupColorModeWatcher = toggle => { const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'); mediaQuery.addListener(() => { // Ignore if there's an override set if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-bs-theme')) { return; } wml.setColorMode(options.colorMode); toggle.checked = mediaQuery.matches; }); }; // DOM Content Loaded document.addEventListener( 'DOMContentLoaded', () => { const fileInput = document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.FILE_INPUT); const dragArea = document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.DRAG_AREA); const buildTime = document.getElementById(ELEMENT_IDS.BUILD_TIME); const darkModeToggle = document.getElementById( ELEMENT_IDS.DARK_MODE_TOGGLE ); // Setup load callback wml.setLoadCallback(() => { dragArea.classList.remove(CSS_CLASS.DRAG_ACTIVE); updateSoundfontName(extractFilename(wml.getUrl())); }); // Display build time buildTime.dateTime = SoundFont.build; buildTime.innerText = new Date(SoundFont.build).toLocaleString(); // Initialize WebMidiLink wml.setup(); // Setup color mode watcher setupColorModeWatcher(darkModeToggle); // File input change handler fileInput.addEventListener( 'change', event => { event.preventDefault(); if (fileInput.files[0]) { loadSoundFont(fileInput.files[0]); fileInput.value = ''; } }, false ); // Setup drag and drop handlers setupDragHandlers(dragArea); // Dark mode toggle handler darkModeToggle.addEventListener('change', e => { wml.setColorMode(e.target.checked ? 'dark' : 'light'); }); }, false ); // Hash change handler window.addEventListener( 'hashchange', () => { const urlParams = qs.parse(window.location.hash); if (urlParams.url) { wml.setup(urlParams.url); } }, false );
